page.title: Invoices
page.subtitle: Bill customers, send quotations and delivery notes, and see what is still owed.
page.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, customer or their order number
page.emptyBody: Make an invoice when a customer will pay later, or a quotation before they decide. Each one goes out with your logo and how to pay.

kindHelp.invoice: Bill a customer who pays now or later
kindHelp.proforma: Price offer they can pay against before you deliver
kindHelp.quotation: Prices for the customer to accept
kindHelp.delivery_note: Goods list without prices, signed on delivery

help.invoice: Nothing changes in stock until you mark the goods delivered. Payments can be recorded before or after.
help.proforma: A price offer the customer can pay against. Turn it into an invoice when they agree.
help.quotation: Prices for the customer to accept. Turn it into an invoice with one click.
help.delivery_note: A list of goods for the driver, without prices. Stock does not change.
help.supplier_invoice: A bill you send to a supplier.

editor.dueDefault: Leave empty to use your usual days to pay

editor.noLinesYet: Add products from stock, or a typed line for a service such as transport or labour.
editor.notesPlaceholder: Shown on the document, e.g. delivery instructions
editor.termsDefaultPlaceholder: Leave empty to use your default terms from Settings

preview.title: Preview

errors.tooMuch: This is more than what is still owed ({amount})

payment.supplierDescription: Take it off what you owe {name}, or record money they paid you. Still owed: {amount}.

deliver.descriptionNoStock: {name} owes this invoice from now. Do this when the work is done.
deliver.supplierDescription: {name} owes this from now: it comes off what you owe them. Products on it leave {shop} stock now.

voidPayment.title: Cancel this payment?
voidPayment.description: {amount} will no longer count as paid. The money record is cancelled too.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {number}?
cancelDialog.description: The document stays in the list as cancelled. Nothing else changes.
cancelDialog.descriptionDelivered: The products go back into stock and the customer no longer owes it. The books are reversed.
